method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How air entering a charcoal clamp changes whether wood chars slowly or burns away to ash.
cases.circumstances: thin smoke becomes a bright flame at one side after wind rises
cases.situation: He needs to preserve the burn without opening the hot clamp carelessly.

cases.knowledge_need: How bellows, fuel bed depth, and iron color help a smith avoid striking metal that is too cold or overheating it.
cases.circumstances: the charcoal has unevenly burned down during a busy afternoon
cases.situation: She is shaping a small iron hook and needs workable heat without wasting fuel.

cases.knowledge_need: How rapid cooling can harden some heated iron work but also risks distortion or cracking in a thin edge.
cases.circumstances: a freshly forged knife blank is thinner near its point
cases.situation: He must cool it in a way that does not ruin the useful shape.

cases.knowledge_need: How soaking flax stalks too briefly or too long affects separation of fiber and the smell of the retting water.
cases.circumstances: warm weather follows several days of rain
cases.situation: She needs fibers that can be dried and processed without excessive rot.

cases.knowledge_need: How soaking willow rods changes their flexibility and why sharply bending dry rods can split them.
cases.circumstances: stored rods dried in a drafty shed
cases.situation: He must finish a carrier that will bear wet vegetables.

cases.knowledge_need: How clean handling, drying rate, and moisture affect a fresh hide before it is worked into durable leather.
cases.circumstances: a hide was delivered late on a humid day
cases.situation: She must prevent spoilage while arranging the next treatment.

cases.knowledge_need: How grain direction, knots, and frozen timber affect safe splitting of a log with wedges.
cases.circumstances: overnight frost hardened a damp oak round
cases.situation: He needs billets without glancing blows or ruined wedges.

cases.knowledge_need: How a small leak in a wooden boat can be distinguished from ordinary bilge water and why bailing must continue while a repair is prepared.
cases.circumstances: water returns quickly after the craft has stood loaded at the bank
cases.situation: He must carry passengers across before the weather worsens.

cases.knowledge_need: How a net snagged on a submerged branch should be freed without tearing mesh or capsizing a small boat.
cases.circumstances: a cross-current pulls the boat broadside while the net is taut
cases.situation: Two people need to recover the catch and retain control of the craft.

cases.knowledge_need: How damp sheaves change threshing, grain separation, and the risk of storing incompletely dried grain.
cases.circumstances: rain began before the last sheaves were brought inside
cases.situation: He must decide whether to thresh now or wait for drier conditions.

cases.knowledge_need: How a light steady breeze can separate chaff from grain while stronger gusts can scatter useful kernels.
cases.circumstances: wind shifts between calm and sudden gusts
cases.situation: She wants cleaner grain without losing a scarce harvest.

cases.knowledge_need: How cold wet soil and waterlogged furrows affect whether sown seed can sprout rather than rot.
cases.circumstances: snowmelt remains in the lower end of the plot
cases.situation: He must choose where planting can begin without wasting seed.

cases.knowledge_need: How repeated cart traffic on wet ground compacts a garden path and redirects surface water toward planted beds.
cases.circumstances: several loads of manure crossed after rain
cases.situation: She needs access for work without leaving crops waterlogged.

cases.knowledge_need: How fresh manure differs from well-rotted manure in heat, odor, and risk to tender plants.
cases.circumstances: a neighbor offers a fresh cartload before seedlings are moved
cases.situation: He must use the material without damaging the young crop.

cases.knowledge_need: How moldy or musty hay can affect livestock and why questionable fodder should not simply be mixed into a larger ration.
cases.circumstances: a damp patch developed under a leaking roof
cases.situation: She must feed animals through the week while protecting them from bad forage.

cases.knowledge_need: How to approach and restrain a frightened sheep caught in thorny brush without increasing injury to animal or handler.
cases.circumstances: the flock is moving away as rain begins
cases.situation: He needs to free the animal before darkness.

cases.knowledge_need: How fresh tracks, disturbed vegetation, and softened ground provide clues while weather can quickly erase or confuse them.
cases.circumstances: light rain began after an animal crossed a muddy path
cases.situation: She must decide whether the trail is recent enough to follow.

cases.knowledge_need: How cloud cover, slope, watercourses, and remembered landmarks can aid orientation when a forest path fades under leaf litter.
cases.circumstances: late-afternoon fog obscures distant trees
cases.situation: He needs a cautious way to return without wandering farther.

cases.knowledge_need: How vegetation mats, open water, and uneven footing signal different risks when crossing a wet bog margin.
cases.circumstances: a familiar summer route is softened by autumn rain
cases.situation: She carries a cutting tool and bundle but must avoid becoming stuck.

cases.knowledge_need: How a cool smoky environment differs from direct heat for preserving meat and why surface drying alone does not prove food is safe.
cases.circumstances: the fire has flared after new fuel was added
cases.situation: He must keep meat from cooking too fast or spoiling during storage.

cases.knowledge_need: How temperature, time, and salt affect rising dough and why a cold room may delay rather than immediately ruin it.
cases.circumstances: morning frost entered through an unshuttered window
cases.situation: She needs bread ready for workers by midday.

cases.knowledge_need: How gentle heating and acidification affect separation of curds and whey without scorching the curds.
cases.circumstances: fresh milk has begun to sour on a warm morning
cases.situation: She wants to turn it into food rather than lose it.

cases.knowledge_need: How swelling, trouble breathing, or widespread rash after eating can signal an urgent reaction rather than ordinary indigestion.
cases.circumstances: a companion worsens soon after an unfamiliar food
cases.situation: The group must recognize danger and seek help rather than continue walking.

cases.knowledge_need: How to protect a fresh minor burn from further heat and contamination without applying irritating substances or tearing damaged skin.
cases.circumstances: hot steam escaped while a lid was lifted
cases.situation: She needs to decide whether the injury can be safely dressed before work resumes.

cases.knowledge_need: How pain, swelling, ability to bear weight, and deformity can guide cautious response after an ankle twists on uneven ground.
cases.circumstances: he stumbled while carrying a light parcel
cases.situation: He must judge whether walking farther risks a worse injury.

cases.knowledge_need: How poor ventilation around a smoky brazier can cause headache or dizziness and why moving fuel alone may not clear the risk.
cases.circumstances: rain has kept doors shut all day
cases.situation: Two workers feel unwell but want to finish before evening.

cases.knowledge_need: How heating water changes some microbial risks but does not make visibly contaminated water safe from every harmful substance.
cases.circumstances: the nearest stream passes a settlement upstream
cases.situation: She must make the least risky drink with limited fuel.

cases.knowledge_need: How layered wool, linen, and an outer cover behave differently when soaked by sustained rain and wind.
cases.circumstances: rain changes to cold wind before shelter is reached
cases.situation: He must reduce heat loss while keeping enough freedom to walk.

cases.knowledge_need: How uneven wetting and poor rinsing can produce blotchy color or staining when dyeing wool yarn.
cases.circumstances: the yarn was bundled tightly before entering the vat
cases.situation: She wants a usable even color without weakening the fiber.

cases.knowledge_need: How a cracked glass vessel can fail unexpectedly under heat or pressure and how sharp fragments create a cutting hazard.
cases.circumstances: a small vessel was dropped but remains mostly intact
cases.situation: He needs to clear it without turning a minor break into injuries.

cases.knowledge_need: How frost, water entry, and unstable bedding can loosen stones in a low wall after winter.
cases.circumstances: one section bulges after repeated freeze and thaw
cases.situation: He must make the wall safe before people lean tools against it.

cases.knowledge_need: How soft ground, angle, and a slippery top support affect whether a wooden ladder can be safely used for roof access.
cases.circumstances: morning dew remains on the wall and ground
cases.situation: She must reach a damaged shutter without a fall.

cases.knowledge_need: How shifting a heavy load closer to the body and using rests changes strain and balance on an uneven path.
cases.circumstances: the carried sack is awkward rather than exceptionally heavy
cases.situation: He must reach the village without falling or exhausting himself.

cases.knowledge_need: How a dry or loose wooden wheel hub can wobble, heat through friction, and damage an axle on a loaded cart.
cases.circumstances: a repetitive knock begins after descending a stony slope
cases.situation: She must decide whether to stop for inspection before continuing with grain.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet fiber rope changes grip and why a load-bearing knot must be checked under tension before people depend on it.
cases.circumstances: rain has soaked the mooring line
cases.situation: He must secure a boat that pulls against the posts in current.

cases.knowledge_need: How moonlight, cloud, wet surfaces, and a carried lamp change what can be seen safely on a narrow path after dark.
cases.circumstances: clouds repeatedly cover the moon after rain
cases.situation: She must avoid a ditch while not wasting scarce lamp fuel.

cases.knowledge_need: How biting insects concentrate near standing water at certain times and how clothing, smoke, and timing can reduce exposure.
cases.circumstances: work continues at warm dusk beside shallow pools
cases.situation: He must finish gathering without constant bites disrupting the team.

cases.knowledge_need: How dead branches, saturated soil, and wind change the risk of sheltering or working beneath a damaged tree.
cases.circumstances: a storm has left one large branch hanging overhead
cases.situation: She must choose a safer route before more wind arrives.
